issue: LLM response can appear infinite because backend treats HTTP stream EOF as completion instead of Ollama done=true terminal frame.
evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/chat/mod.rs: in stream_chat_response, done sets sent_done=true but loop continues; chat:token emits done:false; emit_chat_done happens after loop EOF.
root_cause: Terminal condition conflated provider frame protocol with transport EOF.
fix_direction: On ChatToken{done:true}, append final token if present, collect usage/final metadata, emit terminal event, persist message/receipt, and break immediately. Do not wait for EOF.
acceptance_gate: Add mock provider/stream test that yields tokens then done=true and never EOF; backend must finish within <1s and frontend must leave streaming state.

issue: Terminal done is not emitted as part of chat:token; UI depends on separate chat:done emitted late.
evidence: chat:token emission hardcodes done:false even when token frame had done=true.
root_cause: Backend event schema lost terminal bit; done/delta event split creates race.
fix_direction: Make terminal event explicit: either emit chat:token with done:true exactly once, or emit chat:done immediately on done frame; define one contract and test it.
acceptance_gate: Frontend test receives token, terminal frame, evidence; exactly one assistant message finalized.

issue: Partial streamed output is not durably persisted if provider times out/errors after tokens.
evidence: send_message inserts assistant Message only after stream_chat_response returns Ok. Timeout receipt admits durable partial persistence still needs runtime fixture.
root_cause: Persistence is success-finalization only; partial/error states are UI-local or receipt-only.
fix_direction: Persist a GenerationState row before streaming starts; append/commit partial content on every material chunk or on bounded intervals; mark completed/cancelled/partial_timeout/provider_error terminal state.
acceptance_gate: Kill provider after first token; DB contains assistant partial, PartialGenerationReceiptV1, continuation plan.

issue: Stop streaming can create local frontend partial while backend provider may continue and later emit done/error.
evidence: chatStore.stopStreaming creates local message and clears state; backend cancellation authority not proven.
root_cause: Cancellation lives in two planes: UI approximation and backend runtime are not reconciled.
fix_direction: Make stop_chat backend-authoritative: cancellation token per generation, provider stream aborted, backend emits cancelled terminal event and persists partial exactly once. UI only renders backend state.
acceptance_gate: Stop after two tokens; no duplicate messages; provider future cancelled; DB status=cancelled.

issue: Background summary jobs can hold GPU/LLM gates and make chat appear hung even when Ollama is healthy.
evidence: Summary processor acquires GPU/LLM gates and has 180s process timeout; chat gate waits up to 120s.
root_cause: Foreground and background share scarce gates without preemptive runtime lease semantics.
fix_direction: Introduce priority leases: foreground chat preempts/cancels/degrades background LLM work before waiting; background must use short cancellable slices and never hold GPU across long provider calls.
acceptance_gate: Start fake summary provider blocked; send chat; chat starts within SLO and summary records cancellation/degradation.

issue: Gate wait can look like infinite chat because waiting state is not a terminal/output state and SLOs are too high.
evidence: CHAT_GATE_WAIT_TIMEOUT=120s; provider/first/idle timeouts 180/168/84s.
root_cause: Status surface does not distinguish queued/gate-wait/provider-start/first-token/idle well enough.
fix_direction: Expose streaming phase state to UI with elapsed time, holder owner, cancel button, and hard UX SLO warnings.
acceptance_gate: UI test shows Waiting for LLM gate, then provider started, then first token; stale phase warns after 10s.

issue: Ollama reqwest client has a 300s total body timeout, which conflicts with app-level streaming deadlines.
evidence: src-tauri/src/providers/ollama.rs uses ClientBuilder.connect_timeout(10s).timeout(300s). Reqwest timeout covers until response body finished.
root_cause: Transport-level total timeout is mixed with semantic provider deadlines.
fix_direction: For streaming requests, remove global total timeout or override per request; enforce provider_start, first_token, stream_idle and max_wall_clock in application logic.
acceptance_gate: Slow long generation streams for >300s with active tokens does not die due reqwest total timeout; idle stream dies by app idle deadline.

issue: Timeout receipt claims static/path coverage but live timeout fixture was not exercised.
evidence: TIMEOUT_CHANGE_RECEIPT says live_timeout_fixture_exercised=false and full durable partial persistence needs runtime fixture.
root_cause: Release proof was accepted without live runtime challenge.
fix_direction: Make live timeout fixture mandatory for release gate or mark release blocked.
acceptance_gate: release_candidate_gate fails unless timeout fixture receipt exists and is current.

issue: Max tokens are hardcoded to 2048.

fix_direction: Add generation_max_tokens to settings DB/API/UI with validation bounds; include effective value in GenerationReceiptV1 and provider body num_predict.
acceptance_gate: Change setting to 64; provider mock receives num_predict=64; receipt records 64.
validation_command: cargo test -p gloss generation_max_tokens_setting && npm test

issue: Ollama provider sends think:false but UI/runtime has no explicit receipt field proving thought suppression.

fix_direction: Record think=false / reasoning_output_policy in provider invocation receipt; test no thinking channel displayed.
